scope: Site-only review on November 12, 2026 UTC, separate from the existing corpus census pins. Browser evidence covers the catalogue and all nine record pages at 1280 and 390 pixels, identifier/name searches, category and record-kind filtering, keyboard reset, reload and explicit query URLs, no-JavaScript access and blocked data requests. All 27 publicly packaged manifest assets matched their hashes; the pinned Pages uploader excludes two recorded internal build markers. Deployment 7730250313 remained successful at the same revision before and after the browser pass, with served Last-Modified later than deployment creation. Feature verdicts are reviewed against the existing 24-feature catalogue; missing features are recorded without inferring scientific deficiencies.

search.note: The labelled catalogue search finds both AssayMech:ax17-extracted-feii-ferrozine and its complete assay name, each showing one of nine records with a working record link. Unmatched and literal-markup queries show zero matches.

facets.note: The Category and Record kind selectors filter the complete listing; Bioaccumulation shows one record and Operational assay shows three. Keyboard activation of Reset filters restores all nine and returns focus to the search field.

result_counts.note: Showing N of 9 records responds to search, category, record kind and reset; the empty state retains the total and explains how to recover.

sorting.note: The listing uses a fixed name order and exposes no sort selector or sortable column headings.

shareable_state.note: An explicitly supplied q query parameter restores the searched assay name, but changing filters in the interface does not update the URL; reloading the ordinary search loses its state.

full_catalogue.note: All nine records counted by the manifest have catalogue links and served record pages. The complete nine-record table remains visible with JavaScript disabled.

record_pages.note: Every catalogue record has a stable records/<slug>/index.html page. All nine render populated identity, evidence, limitations, gap and provenance sections; method, measurement, controls and scoped relationships appear where recorded.

term_links.note: Ontology groundings show readable METPO labels, identifiers and relation roles, with a pinned ontology-source link. The term identifiers themselves are plain text, and the source link opens the complete ontology file rather than a term page.

evidence.note: Record pages render recorded evidence URLs as Source reference links beside claim summaries, source locators and source licences. The Ax17 assay links the primary methods and results, its ontology grounding and its scoped CMM relationships.

review_status.note: Ontology assay concept and Operational assay identify record kinds. The pages do not state a whole-record curation or review status.

curation_history.note: Each record's Curation provenance table shows its recorded timestamp, action, curator and change summary, with a link to the history source.

source_link.note: Each record links its own YAML on GitHub at the displayed repository revision and offers the same source YAML as a site download; the public source-file hashes match the manifest.

domain_view.note: The published catalogue and record pages provide text and tables; no assay workflow, measurement diagram or relationship visualization is offered.

cross_mech_links.note: The operational assay records link specific CMMMech source records at recorded revisions. The Ax17 assay links iron and ferrihydrite records with the mechanism locator, experimental scope and the distinction between an Fe(II) endpoint and mineral identification.

corpus_stats.note: The landing page shows nine records: six ontology assay concepts and three operational assays. Its category counts are six microbial-characterization records and one each for bioaccumulation, bioprocessing and biotransformation, matching the manifest.

category_browse.note: Category counts appear as static tiles and the catalogue has a working category filter, but no linked category pages or category index routes are published.

suite_nav.note: The visible All Mech projects navigation link leads to the maintained X-Mech Suite directory from the catalogue and every record page.

downloads.note: Every record offers its YAML and the footer links a corpus manifest, but the site does not link a bulk export containing all record content.

schema_docs.note: The footer links the raw LinkML YAML schema. No rendered schema documentation or class/slot browsing page is published in this site artifact.

license.note: Catalogue and record footers state CC-BY-4.0 for curated records and CC0 for original code and schemas, link both licence and data-rights notices, and retain upstream attribution. These agree with the repository LICENSE.

build_provenance.note: Every page states the repository revision and corpus/schema SHA-256 stamps; the linked corpus manifest records the same deployed revision and per-file hashes.

theme_toggle.note: No theme toggle is offered. Emulating a dark operating-system preference leaves the same light page background.

responsive.note: The catalogue and all nine record pages have no document overflow at 390 pixels. Wide catalogue and history tables stay inside labelled, keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll regions.

load_failure.note: The catalogue and record content are server-rendered HTML. No fetch or XHR data requests occurred across the ten pages; blocking those request types left search functional, and all records remain accessible without JavaScript.
